fact: The Interior Minister told the National Assembly that 164,944 CNIE cards have been produced and 147,224 collected by holders, from the enrolment campaign begun in 2024.
Gabon launched a new generation national digital ID system in July 2024, which the government says it is now moving to operationalise.
The sixth e-Gabon-SIS steering committee on 8 September 2026 reviewed the deployment of a National Digital Identity System, per ANINF.

Gabon opened workshops on 23 June 2025 to start implementing extension of the biometric persons register (RBPP) and a national digital ID system (SNID), financed by the World Bank, with the roadmap a precondition for projects to begin.
Gabon's government says the new electronic national ID card, issued from June 2024, carries a chip and a unique 14-digit personal identification number (NIP) issued on capture of biometric data.

The Interior Ministry says it launched on 3 April 2024 the issue of a 14-character Numero d'Identification Personnel to each citizen after biometric enrolment, under law 027/2020, ahead of the electronic ID card.
Gabon Digital, financed by the World Bank, plans a biometric register of persons covering the whole territory and a national digital identification system, per the workshop's component 2 coordinator.
Gabon Digital component 2 includes the biometric register of natural persons (RBPP) to record people living in Gabon, still at the preparatory stage with a workshop from 28 Sep to 8 Oct 2026.
GabonReview says the SNID is being set up under a law on the NIP number integrated in the electronic national ID card and the IBOGA biometric base of fingerprints and facial recognition.
Techies reports the NIP, a unique identifier for each citizen, began to be attributed on 3 April 2024 in Libreville, and issuing of the electronic national identity card (CNIE) began on 24 June 2024.

The governor of Ogooué-Maritime launched issuance of the chip-based electronic national identity card (CNIE) in Port-Gentil on 13 December 2024, applications requiring a Personal Identification Number (NIP) attestation, through the DGDI.
